Name: Marnie Sells Animal Products (1.6 compatible)
Author: TaisceRayne
Description:
[size=3]I know there are many shop mods out there, but I wanted something with all the animal products [size=3] (mostly for cooking reasons)[/size] and the auto petter. And, most importantly, I wanted something that was compatible with Version 1.6.

This mod adds the following to the [size=3]bottom[/size] of Marnie's sale menu:[/size]

[u]Eggs:[/u][list]
[*]Brown Eggs - 50
[*]White Eggs - 50
[*]Large Brown Eggs - 95
[*]Large White Eggs - 95
[*]Duck Eggs - 95
[*]Ostrich Eggs - 600
[*]Void Eggs - 65
[*]Dino Eggs - 350
[*]Gold Eggs - 500
[/list][u]
Milk:[/u]
[list]
[*]Milk - 125
[*]Goat Milk - 225
[*]Large Milk - 190
[*]Large Goat Milk - 345
[/list]
[u]Mayo:[/u]
[list]
[*]Mayo - 190
[*]Duck Mayo - 375
[*]Void Mayo - 275
[*]Dino Mayo - 800
[/list]
[u]Cheese:[/u]
[list]
[*]Cheese - 230
[*]Goat Cheese - 400
[/list]
[u]Misc:[/u]
[list]
[*]Wool - 340
[*]Duck Feather - 250
[*]Rabbit's Foot - 565
[*]Truffles - 625
[*]Auto Petter - 25,000 (match the price of the auto-grabber)
[*]Auto Grabber (year 1) - 25,000
[/list]
All prices are based on the sale price of the item, and are easily configurable using GMCM, as well as the ability to enable or disable the items. All products are buyable starting in year 1! (screenshots were taken with a save where I fully befriended Marnie so the prices on the photos are incorrect)

[size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size]
No known issues with any other mods. If you have a mod that completely overrides the animal shop list then I could see those conflicting.

[size=4][b]To Install:[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]! Just drag this bad boy into your mods folder and you should be good to go! If you want to change the prices, you can edit the config.json or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to edit it right in your game!

[size=4][b]To Uninstall:[/b][/size]
Delete it! Shouldn't cause any issues in current playthroughs, it only touches the animal shop.

[size=4][b]Recommended Mods[/b][/size]:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20985]Self-Serve[/url] to access the shop even when she isn't there
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20648]Friendships Affect Prices[/url] for obvious reasons
Pierre Shop Upgrade to add all seeds, sprinklers, and sprinkler attachments to Pierre's shop (coming soon!)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26961]Robin Sells Machines[/url] to add most machines and materials to Robin's shop
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27102]Clint Shop Overhaul[/url] for machines that felt they fit Clint's shop more
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27249]Willy Sells Fish Machines[/url] for machines that felt they fit Willy's shop more
